about.title: About
about.p1: I have 2+ years of professional experience building software. I currently work remotely as a Full Stack Developer at Coordenadas.co, and before that I was a Junior Backend Engineer at Sibartech, running Django, FastAPI and PostgreSQL in production.
about.p2: At Coordenadas I merged two payroll and tax withholding tools into Bikans, now in production with two-factor authentication, and integrated QuickBooks Online through an n8n agent in 4 days. I also build plugins and integrations for U.S. clients and maintain the infrastructure on a Linux server with Docker, Coolify and Traefik.
about.p3: I'm in my 10th semester of Systems Engineering at Universidad de San Buenaventura. My thesis is a multi-agent system that detects IDN homograph phishing domains, validated with 359 automated tests. I'm now building a LangGraph agent that drafts my blog and publishes nothing without my approval.

cv.title: Resume
cv.strengthsList: Technical ownership · Troubleshooting under deadline pressure · Async communication · Client communication across industries · Self-directed learning · Remote autonomy
cv.summaryText: Full Stack Developer and AI Engineer with 2+ years of professional software development experience building and deploying SaaS products, REST APIs, and automation workflows, plus AI-powered systems using multi-agent architectures, RAG pipelines, and LLM integrations. Proficient in Python, React, FastAPI, Django, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, LlamaStack, Ollama, ChromaDB, Docker, and Linux. Experienced in authentication, third-party API integrations, production troubleshooting, and remote collaboration with international clients.
